name: k8s events dead-man — no Warning events for 3 h
description: Fires when ZERO rows arrive in the k8s-events dataset in the trailing 180 min (evaluated every 60 min). The poweredge-xubuntu collector's k8sobjects/events receiver watches every Kubernetes event of type Warning; that watch can die on its own while the rest of the collector keeps emitting, so k8s-cluster-state-silent does not cover it. It did exactly that at 2026-11-06T00:55:59Z, when the API server stopped serving in the 11-05 saturation incident, and stayed dead for five days. WINDOW: measured Warning volume 2026-11-01..11-06 ran 1..4436 per hour with many single-event hours, so a 20 min window would fire on a quiet cluster; 3 h of total silence would not. UNGROUPED and unfiltered, because a grouped query cannot fire on a silent subject. Emitter: thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml on poweredge-xubuntu. Runbook: on poweredge-xubuntu read `journalctl -u otel-collector | grep -E 'k8sobjects|retrywatcher'`; if the events watch is dead, re-establish it with `mise exec -- just ansible-apply ansible/restart-otel-collector.yml -e otel_collector_restart_confirm=poweredge-xubuntu` under the credential wrapper. Plan kubernetes-observability (livespec-dev-tooling-s2aqob), item livespec-dev-tooling-a4rd4f.
